children: GREYSTONE LOGISTICS, INC. reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue down to $27.54M and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $8.24M (diluted EPS ($0.3)), versus $57.87M revenue and $1.92M net income (EPS $0.07) in FY2025.
¹ Reported as “Sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share of common stock”.
Revenue decline driven principally by a roughly 60–65% drop in demand from two major customers.
In-house production capacity is approximately 2.7M pallets per year; production and margins were reduced by lower volumes and fixed-cost leverage.
Cost of sales rose to about 106% of sales in FY2026, reflecting underutilized manufacturing and higher per-unit costs.
Management implemented tighter expense controls, reduced temporary labor, and is pursuing market expansion and price adjustments to stabilize margins.
Insurance receivables from prior warehouse/fire losses were settled and collected during FY2026, providing a working capital benefit.
